name: The Onakke spirits
description: Spirits carried by the Chain Veil that fill Liliana's mind with whispers.

timeline.summary: Liliana walks Ravnica's Second District, hearing the Onakke voices and brooding that Jace chose to help Gideon instead of her.
timeline.quote: But he hadn't. Instead, he had agreed to help Gideon.

pages_say.description: Spirits carried by the Chain Veil that fill Liliana's mind with whispers.
An ogre civilization once at home on Shandalar, adept at using its abundant mana to craft artifacts of terrible power.
